display_name: Nymeria - Project Aria headset + miniAria wristband IMUs (decimated to 200 Hz)
placement: the head (Project Aria glasses), the left wrist and the right wrist (miniAria wristbands), simultaneous
note: One IMU per device (imu-right / 1202-1 at ~800 Hz preferred, imu-left / 1202-2 at ~1 kHz as fallback; the choice is recorded per run in manifest.json). Aria reports accel in m/s^2 and gyro in rad/s already in the device frame; accel is divided by 9.80665 -> g, gravity PRESENT. Non-uniform device timestamps are resampled onto the sensor's nominal uniform clock, then anti-alias filtered and decimated to exactly 200 Hz (scipy.signal.resample_poly, Kaiser FIR, cutoff at the 100 Hz output Nyquist). 200 Hz is far above the frontend's ~14 Hz f_max; keeping 1 kHz would cost 5x for nothing. Gaps > 0.5 s split the session into _pNN parts rather than being interpolated across. The observer headset is excluded: it is worn by a second person following the participant. Unlabeled: reserved marker __unlabeled__, Phase-A only. Grids are float16.
